description: Elderly applicants with adult children abroad are assessed as likely to overstay. The very fact that establishes the reason to visit is the reason for refusal.
energy_note: Family ties recast as immigration risk.

description: Each refusal costs the fee and must be declared on the next application, so persistence makes success less likely.
money_note: Fees plus travel to a third country to apply.

description: Under the 2026 US full suspension, an Iranian parent cannot attend a child's graduation, wedding or funeral. The loss is not recoverable later.
energy_note: The one cost nobody can be compensated for.

description: A couple marrying abroad, where neither set of parents can obtain a visitor visa, either marries without family or does not marry.
energy_note: Your parents watch on a phone screen.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the grandparent who never meets the child
description: Under the January 2026 US suspension there is no visitor route at all, so a grandchild born in 2026 may not meet a grandparent before that grandparent dies.
energy_note: A person who will die before meeting their grandchild.

description: Omid and Maryam marry in Toronto in 2026. Both sets of parents apply for visitor visas. All four are refused: insufficient ties, and an adult child resident in Canada. The ceremony has eleven guests, nine of whom the couple met after arriving.
energy_note: Married in a room with no one who watched you grow up.
